title: 第28章 鲁长老
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
那点暗金粉末刚冒头，陈青山一铲就把它压了回去。

    他没急着抠，也没急着动鼎。

    心念一收，这点粉末本可以神不知鬼不觉地进识海。

    可方大河那句“灰比别处肥”还在耳边——是真肥，还是钓鱼的坑，他心里没底。来路不明的东西，先看清是肥是坑，再决定往不往鼎里塞。

    头一天，他什么本事都不想露，连鼎都懒得动，就当个老老实实铲灰的穷杂役。

    炉边人来人往，方大河虽走了，洞里却不缺眼睛。

    识海里的造化鼎闹腾归闹腾，他这具肉身得稳住。

    先铲灰。

    第一铲下去，他就懂了方大河那句“灰比别处肥”是什么意思。

    别的炉子，灰是死的，铲起来轻飘飘。三号这炉，灰底压着一层结块的渣，铁铲一刮，底下噗地窜起一股暗红热气，直冲脸门。

    陈青山躲得慢了半拍。

    热气灌进喉咙，又干又辣，像吞了一把烧红的沙子。他猛地别过头，咳得肩膀直抖，眼角逼出一点泪。

    “咳……咳咳……”

    旁边扒灰的老刘抬眼，乐了：“新来的，三号是吧？”

    “嗯。”陈青山缓过一口气，嗓子哑得不像话。

    “那炉灰呛人，头三天你就当戒奶了。”老刘自己说完自己先笑，又被笑岔了气，咳得比他还凶，“滚……滚你娘的火。”

    陈青山陪着笑，把护口布往上提了提，重新探铲。

    这活儿没巧。

    铲、抖、装袋，铲、抖、装袋。灰一扬，半张脸就糊一层，汗一流，就成了泥。他眼睛被熏得睁不开，索性半眯着干，靠手感找炉底的实灰。

    一炉灰，三袋。

    他装到第二袋时，胳膊就开始发酸，后背的汗把粗布衣裳贴在肉上，撕都撕不下来。喉咙更是冒火，咽口唾沫都疼。

    可他没停。

    苦活越像样，越没人盯着他这个人。一个累得直不起腰、咳得快背过气的穷杂役，谁会去琢磨他手里那点火候？

    倒是那暗金粉，他装袋时不动声色地把这块炉底的灰单拢出来，借着抹汗、挪铲子的工夫，一点点扒到自己脚边那堆扫地碎渣里。

    要交的是三袋够秤的灰，这点炉底渣不入数，也没人会盯着一个新杂役脚下那点扫不干净的废末。

    不抠出来，也不混进要上交的袋子，只悄悄留在脚边。等天黑收工，混着随身的破布灰土一并带走。

    是肥是坑，回屋慢慢验。

    就这么干到第二炉清了一半，洞里忽然静了一下。

    不是全静。人声还在，却都往低里压了半截。原本骂骂咧咧扒灰的几个杂役，腰弯得更下，铲子声也轻了，连老刘的咳嗽都硬生生憋了回去。

    陈青山直起腰。

    火井那头，他先前以为是堆废料的地方，动了一动。

    一个老头从阴影里坐了起来。

    说“坐起来”都勉强。那老头干瘦干瘦，皮包着骨头，脸上的褶子比炉壁上的裂纹还密，灰扑扑缩在火井边的石台上，方才一动不动，活像一截被人忘在那儿的枯树根。

    陈青山心里咯噔一下。

    这老头什么时候在那儿的？他从进洞就没瞧见。

    “方大河！”

    老头一开口，嗓子破得厉害，声音却压住了整个洞子的热浪。

    方大河不知从哪个旮旯钻出来，点头哈腰：“鲁长老，您醒了。”

    “老子没睡。”鲁长老眼皮都没全抬，“三号炉的对牌你又随手发了？穷得叮当响的也敢往火脉里塞。烧死一个，功德殿那帮孙子又来扯老子的皮。”

    “看走眼了看走眼了。”方大河搓手，“这小子耐热，撑了十息——”

    “撑十息就往三号塞？”鲁长老一拐杖捅在方大河腿弯上，把人捅得一个趔趄，“你当那是练气炉？滚一边去。”

    方大河捂着腿，缩到一边，冲陈青山挤了个“别怕”的眼色。

    鲁长老的目光这才转过来，落在陈青山身上。

    那眼睛陷在皱纹里，浑浊得像蒙了一层灰。可不知怎么，被他这么一扫，陈青山后背刚冒的汗，一下就凉了。
content_en:
As soon as the dark gold powder appeared, Chen Qingshan pushed it back with a shovel.

    He was not in a hurry to dig, nor was he in a hurry to move the cauldron.

    After thinking about it, this little powder could have entered the sea of ​​consciousness without anyone noticing.

    But Fang Dahe's words "Ashes are fatter than other places" are still in his ears - whether they are really fat or just a fishing trap, he is not sure. For things of unknown origin, you should first see whether they are fat or pitfalls, and then decide whether to stuff them into the tripod.

    On the first day, he didn't want to show off any of his abilities. He didn't even bother to move the cauldron, so he just acted as a poor boy shoveling dust.

    People were coming and going by the fireside. Although Fang Dahe was gone, there was no shortage of eyes in the cave.

    The cauldron of creation in the sea of ​​​​consciousness is noisy and noisy, and his physical body must be stable.

    Shovel the ashes first.

    After the first shovel, he understood what Fang Dahe meant when he said "ash is fatter than other places".

    In other stoves, the ashes are dead and light when shoveled. In furnace No. 3, there is a layer of caked slag pressed against the ash bottom. When the shovel is scraped, a burst of dark red hot air rises from the bottom and goes straight to the face.

    Chen Qingshan hid for a moment.

    The hot air filled my throat, dry and spicy, like swallowing a handful of red-hot sand. He turned his head away suddenly, coughing so hard that his shoulders shook, and he forced a little tear out of the corner of his eye.

    "Cough... cough cough..."

    Old Liu, who was picking up ashes next to him, raised his eyes and said happily: "The new one is number three, right?"

    "Yes." Chen Qingshan took a breath, his voice was hoarse.

    "The ashes are choking, so you should stop breastfeeding in the first three days." After Lao Liu said it, he laughed first, then was distracted by the laughter, and coughed harder than him, "Get out... get out of your mother's anger."

    Chen Qingshan laughed along with him, lifted up the mouth guard, and explored the shovel again.

    This is no coincidence.

    Shovel, shake, bag. Shovel, shake, bag. As soon as the ashes rise, half of the face becomes smeared, and as soon as the sweat begins, it turns into mud. His eyes were so smoked that he couldn't keep them open, so he simply half-squinted and looked for the solid ashes at the bottom of the furnace by feeling.

    One furnace ashes, three bags.

    When he loaded the second bag, his arms began to feel sore, and the sweat on his back stuck the coarse clothes to his flesh, making it impossible to tear them off. My throat was even more on fire, and it hurt to swallow my saliva.

    But he didn't stop.

    The more decent the hard work is, the less people will pay attention to him. A poor handyman who is so tired that he can't stand up straight and coughs so hard that he almost loses his breath. Who would think about the little fire in his hand?

    As for the dark gold powder, when he was bagging it, he calmly gathered up the ash sheet from the bottom of the stove, and by wiping sweat and moving the shovel, he scooped it bit by bit into the pile of sweeping debris at his feet.

    What you have to pay is three bags of ash that can be weighed. This is not the slag at the bottom of the furnace, and no one will look at the scraps at the feet of a new handyman that cannot be swept away.

    Neither dig it out nor put it into the bag to be handed in, just quietly stay at your feet. When it gets dark, the work is done, and the rags and dust are mixed with them and taken away together.

    Whether it is fat or a pit, go back to the house and check it slowly.

    This was done until half of the second furnace was cleared, and the cave suddenly became quiet.

    Not completely silent. The voices were still there, but they were half lowered. The handymen who were scolding and scooping the ashes bent down further, the sound of the shovels became softer, and even Lao Liu's cough was suppressed.

    Chen Qingshan straightened up.

    At the other end of the fire well, where he thought it was a pile of scrap materials, there was movement.

    An old man sat up from the shadows.

    It's hard to say "sit up". The old man was skinny and skinny, his skin covered with bones, and the wrinkles on his face were denser than the cracks on the furnace wall. He was huddled in ashes on the stone platform beside the fire well, motionless just now, like a dead tree root that had been forgotten there.

    Chen Qingshan's heart skipped a beat.

    When was this old man there? He hadn't seen it since he entered the cave.

    "Fang Dahe!"

    When the old man opened his mouth, his throat was severely broken, but his voice suppressed the heat in the entire cave.

    Fang Dahe emerged from nowhere, nodded and bowed: "Elder Lu, you're awake."

    "I'm awake." Elder Lu didn't even raise his eyelids. "You randomly dealt out the matching cards in No. 3 Furnace again? You are so poor that you dare to stuff it into the fire veins. If you burn one of them to death, the grandsons from the Hall of Merit will come to take advantage of me again."

    "I made a mistake." Fang Dahe rubbed his hands, "This kid can withstand heat and lasted ten breaths——"

    "You're going to stuff it into No. 3 after ten breaths?" Elder Lu stabbed Fang Dahe on the crook of his leg with his crutch, causing him to stumble. "Do you think that's a Qi training furnace? Get out of the way."

    Fang Dahe covered his legs, shrank to one side, and gave Chen Qingshan a "don't be afraid" look.

    Elder Lu's eyes then turned and fell on Chen Qingshan.

    The eyes were sunk in wrinkles and were as cloudy as if they were covered with a layer of dust. But for some reason, the sweat on Chen Qingshan's back suddenly turned cold after being swept away by him.
